whyThisFileAndNotAnotherWay: No in-process alternative exists: the tool registry is reachable only from inside a mounted plugin tree, and --dump-config never executes plugin code (AGENTS.md §4), so it cannot witness a registered tool.

The probe is the repo's SANCTIONED instrumentation channel: QA-only, already mounted by the QA overlays (tests/overlays/roles-probe.yml), already used to prove the adapter seams and the roster, never shipped in the bundle. Reading the live registry there is the same technique ADAPTER_SEAMS already uses.
A pure log-grep would be weaker: it asserts a string appeared, not that the harness REGISTRY contains the tool. The probe reads the registry.
Driving the tools through a real session proves callability but needs a live credential and cannot enumerate the registry; the probe is deterministic and offline.
